description: This file is a PHP class for handling sale order reports within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines a controller class `SaleOrder` with methods for displaying, saving, and retrieving sale order report data, including filtering, pagination, and exporting report views.

classes.name: SaleOrder
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale order reports in the OpenCart admin extension. It offers functionalities to display report forms, process and save report settings, generate report data based on filters, and list reports with pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the sale order report form page with filtering options and initial setup.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves report configuration settings, e.g., filter criteria, via POST data, with permission check.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the main sale order report based on current filters and settings.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report data list, typically in response to AJAX requests.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves report data, filtered by date, group, status, and paginated, returning HTML or JSON for display.
